text_block_list.text:
During summer camp, Эйсин Флэш senses

something in my troubled gaze as I
watch over
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When she asks me what's wrong, I
respond
honestly that I'm trying to
remember as much of
these last moments
as possible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how much I love to see her
running,
which gets us reminiscing about
our journey thus
far. Эйсин Флэш
confesses that she doesn't want
our time
to end just yet either.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
